title: Timetable interview
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y8 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: timetable interview)
intro: Lesson 35: Asking the time and the times of my day. To understand how to ask at what time things happen and answer with فِي السَّاعَةِ

questions.model: Teacher: change تَنَامُ (you sleep) to أَنَامُ (I sleep); then فِي السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ, kasrah throughout.

questions.q: Timetable interview in breakout pairs: ask five فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ ...؟ questions about each other's weekday (wake, Fajr, lessons start, Qur'an, sleep) and write the answers in a timetable on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Five correct questions and answers with kasrah after فِي
questions.model: Teacher and a pupil model: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ؟ أَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّابِعَةِ مَسَاءً.

questions.q: report one answer about your partner with هُوَ / هِيَ.
questions.a: For example: هُوَ يَنَامُ فِي السَّاعَةِ العَاشِرَةِ

questions.q: Back to our ponder: when do you need each question?
questions.a: Now: كَمِ السَّاعَةُ؟; when: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ؟
